name: Banh mi op la
summary: A fried-egg breakfast on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng. The 18 May 2020 page calls it bánh mì ốp la. The 19 Jun 2019 roundup lists ốp la on the same street. Neither page describes the bread or the egg.
origin: Named on the Da Nang breakfast street. It is a separate line from the filled bánh mì.
howToEat: The breakfast pages name the egg and do not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the morning. The 2020 page says the street is crowded from 06:00 to 08:00. The 2019 page prints 06:00–12:00.
seoTitle: Banh mi op la — fried egg on the breakfast street
seoDescription: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng names bánh mì ốp la in 2020 and ốp la in 2019. The pages do not describe the bread or the egg. Check on arrival.
